name: set_event_effect_position

stack.evidence: func_001DF490 consumes an effect ID and three coordinates, resolves the ID through func_001775E8, and decrements Script stackTop by four

notes: func_001775E8 resolves effect_id in the D_0035C010 event-effect manager. When the entry exists, func_001DF490 converts x, y, and z to floats and stores them at offsets 0x00, 0x04, and 0x08 of the effect's runtime object. This is the event-effect counterpart of command 167 set_map_effect_position. The JP corpus contains 33 calls.
